purpose: Revised 3-card candidate sample for CET4 listening box 0034 after the existing sample was blocked by agent self-review.

source_policy.source_note: Uses legacy content_pool transcripts with unverified provenance as simulated training material. Do not label as true exam content.

front.text: 听完后，选出她没参加 morning session 的原因。
front.task_prompt: because 后面才是原因；不要把 could not attend 这个结果当成原因。

options.text: Her doctor's appointment ran longer than expected.
The morning session was moved to another room.
She forgot the time of the morning session.
She had already attended the session earlier.

task_schema.focus: because 从句中的 doctor appointment ran longer
task_schema.success_criteria: 能区分 she could not attend 是结果，because 后的 appointment ran longer 是原因

audio.transcript: She couldn't attend the morning session because she had a doctor's appointment that ran longer than expected.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 A。She couldn't attend the morning session 是结果；because she had a doctor's appointment that ran longer than expected 才是原因。时间因果题最容易把主句结果和从句原因混在一起，尤其是结果先出现时。B、C、D 都没有音频依据，也没有被 because 引出。
tips: because/since/as 后面通常才是原因内容。
先标记“发生了什么”，再标记“为什么”。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 because 引出的具体原因

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户把结果和 because 后的具体原因分开，避免听到第一个事件就误选。

front.text: 听完后，选出男生去图书馆的最初目的。
front.task_prompt: 题目问 purpose，先定位去某地时的不定式目的；ended up 后面是最后发生的事。

task_schema.focus: initial purpose marker / later result boundary
task_schema.success_criteria: 能区分去某地时的目的和后来实际发生的结果

audio.transcript: He went to the library to return some books and ended up spending the whole afternoon studying for his finals.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 B。He went to the library to return some books 中，to return some books 表示最初目的；ended up spending the whole afternoon studying for his finals 是后来实际发生的结果。时间因果题常把目的和最终结果放在同一句里，最后听到的动作不一定是题目要的答案。A 是最终行为，C、D 没有音频依据。
tips: go/head/come + to do 往往表示目的。
ended up/eventually 后面常是结果，不要自动当成原因或目的。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 区分最初目的和最终行为

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户按题目角度区分 purpose 和 result，避免被最后出现的信息带偏。

front.text: 听完后，选出演唱会被取消的原因。
front.task_prompt: due to 后面是名词短语型原因；后一句是后续处理信息，不是取消原因。

options.text: A delay in selling enough tickets.
The plan to reschedule it for next month.

task_schema.action: 选择 due to 引出的原因
task_schema.focus: due to noun-phrase cause / follow-up arrangement
task_schema.success_criteria: 能选出 due to 引出的取消原因，并排除后续处理信息

audio.transcript: The outdoor concert was cancelled due to the severe weather forecast issued by the meteorological bureau. Organizers apologized and promised to reschedule the event for next month.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 A。The outdoor concert was cancelled due to the severe weather forecast 中，due to 引出取消原因，核心名词是 severe weather forecast。Organizers apologized and promised to reschedule the event for next month 是后续处理，不是原因。时间因果题里，due to/because of 后面的名词短语很短，必须马上抓核心名词。B、C、D 都没有形成正确因果关系。
tips: due to/because of 后面常接名词短语型原因。
后续安排、道歉、改期通常是结果或处理，不是取消原因。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 due to 引出的名词短语原因

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户快速识别短而密的 due to 原因短语，并把后续处理信息排除出原因答案。
